name: cf-task-hub
description: Multi-tenant Cloudflare task hub for Baidu Netdisk and Bilibili VIP coupon tasks

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:worker && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm run db:remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:http && npm run build && npm run dry-run
scripts.deploy:first: npm run check && wrangler deploy && npm run db:remote

DATA_KEY.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte AES-GCM key, set after first deployment.

BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN.description: One-time administrator setup token; 32+ random bytes.

IDENTITY_KEY.description: Independent persistent base64url 32-byte HMAC key. Keep stable when DATA_KEY rotates.
